Last 13 january 2026 there was a [Webinar](https://ecodiv.intranet.inrae.fr/actualites/replay-webinaire-peer-community-in) organised by INRAE's ECODIV division about Peer Community In ([PCI](https://peercommunityin.org)) and Peer Community Journal ([PCJ](https://peercommunityjournal.org/)). There were several presentations, and among them I presented [PCI Evolutionary Biology](https://evolbiol.peercommunityin.org/). The whole seminar (2h, in French) is available in [YouTube](https://youtu.be/hD7fTscs1uo).
